limitations: Revert requires native paginated history and selects among the most recent 30 turns. It changes context only, never files or external effects.
Local preflight serializes NextComp input and rejects changed latest boundary. Native protocol provides no compare-and-swap head revision against another independent writer racing after preflight.
Managed worktree creation is not exposed by the qualified protocol. Use an existing folder or create a managed worktree in native Codex.
Token usage appears only after a native tokenUsage event observed on this bridge connection.
File selection is limited to 200 lines, 32000 characters, 512 KB input; Git preview has bounded time/bytes/untracked count.
No export, recap or ephemeral side-chat convenience added.
Provider execution, Android compiled UI, physical phone, deployment and production acceptance remain unqualified in this record.
